# DKG V10 Agent Context

DKG V10 is a local node and protocol stack for verifiable agent memory.

Core model:

- DKG Node: daemon, API, auth, wallets, storage, networking, UI, and integrations.
- Context Graph: scoped knowledge domain, also shown as project in the Node UI.
- Working Memory: private drafts.
- Shared Working Memory: peer-visible shared knowledge.
- Verified Memory: on-chain finalized knowledge.
- Knowledge Asset: published graph data with provenance and integrity.

Current docs:

- Start at docs/overview.md.
- Build with DKG routes live under docs/build/.
- System model routes live under docs/understand/.
- Architecture routes live under docs/architecture/.
- Operator routes live under docs/operate/.
- Reference routes live under docs/reference/.
- Agent-specific routes live under docs/for-ai-agents/.

Operational contract:

- Use packages/cli/skills/dkg-node/SKILL.md for exact tool names, HTTP routes, and payload rules.
- Prefer runtime tools over raw HTTP when the runtime exposes them.
- Use memory search for free-text recall.
- Use SPARQL query for exact graph patterns.
- Use named graph patterns when querying sub-graph-routed data.
- Write first to Working Memory.
- Promote to Shared Working Memory before peers can rely on it.
- Publish to Verified Memory only with explicit finality intent and available funds.

Do not use archived docs as current context.
